independence: Did not perform the source API calls or prepare the root observed summary; independently calculated from the saved raw source. This reviewer also authored the sanitized checkpoint, so this is not a separate second-person review of that output.
exact_arithmetic: Sum integer cents converted from Decimal(amount)*100 with integral-cent checks; independently compare Decimal sums. Units sum currentQuantity, not line count or historic ordered quantity.
window_logic: Parse timezone-aware raw creation timestamps in memory; apply inclusive start/exclusive end. Compute trailing24h as cutoff minus24hours and completed day using America/New_York midnight boundaries. Only membership booleans and public window boundaries are exported.
join_logic: Require four distinct private request/order IDs matching all four current source rows; check same shop and equality of each returned financial status, fulfillment status, current subtotal and recorded refund. Sum fulfillment quantities by private product+variant pair and compare within currently ordered quantities. No identifiers are exported.
pagination_logic: One order page reports hasNextPage=false; all nine order line items fit complete connections. Four fulfillment calls return one fulfillment below first50 cap; its two fulfillment lines and empty event connection report hasNextPage=false. The fulfillment list itself has no pageInfo.
comparison_limit: The prior public report contains no stable private identity mapping accessible in this scope. Current ordinal labels, matching amounts and creation-window counts do not prove historical product/basket identity or exclude offsetting order-level changes.
source_semantic_limits: Qualified totals are current Shopify order-state amounts and current quantities, not settled or retained cash, delivered revenue or profit.
One cancelled row remains PAID with zero current amount/units and totalRefundedSet=0.00. No refund, cancellation cause, cash settlement or retention conclusion is drawn.

Anonymous record ordinals apply only to this capture. No historical identity or product/basket mapping is inferred from matching amounts, quantities or statuses; order-level lifecycle changes remain unverified across checkpoints.

The FULFILLED/SUCCESS source status, two fulfillment units and one tracking-company record are administrative fulfillment evidence. No events, inTransitAt, deliveredAt or estimatedDeliveryAt were returned; carrier acceptance, physical transit and delivery remain unverified.
Order creation coverage ends at the exclusive order cutoff. Four fulfillment reads occurred later and in parallel; the combined snapshot is not atomic and cannot describe every intermediate state.
The creation filter covers September5 onward. It does not find older orders whose fulfillment or refund changed later, and an unchanged aggregate does not rule out offsetting lifecycle changes.
The trailing24h and completed shop-day values use different moving windows from the previous report; the lower window total is not a new negative sale or business deterioration by itself.
No attribution journey, receiver, GA4, Ads, cost, payout, settlement, customer or product research was performed. No CPA, ROAS, profit, cash or delivery improvement is claimed.
recommended_integration: Refresh aggregate order/fulfillment evidence clocks only. Keep totals3orders/8units/USD207.25 and zero new creations; retain cancellation/refund, carrier/delivery, identity, attribution and profit limits. Root preserves existing paid/goal/schedule/owner controls and removes the restricted source only after its verification.
